Procurement's legal review just came back an hour ago: EU customer audit events must be stored in the eu-west-1 region, and only StreamForge offers eu-west-1 under the shortlisted contracts. NimbusMQ does not meet this data-residency requirement. I haven't attached these terms to the architecture review yet, but this effectively means the current draft recommendation for NimbusMQ can't proceed as-is.

Can you get the legal review terms formally attached to the architecture review record? Once that's documented, I'll move to formally approve StreamForge as the selected service so we can keep the production integration timeline on track for next month.
